notes.title: Minor Update: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Minor fixes to Wick: No Way Out.

- Stopped Benny from sliding on his face when he goes to sleep.
- Fixed translation error in Spanish when unlocking No Way Out content.
- Fixed mouse and keyboard menu controls from conflicting.
- Fixed button positioning in some menus.
- Fixed collision of some of the in-game props.

notes.title: NO WAY OUT: New content is available TODAY and it is FREE!
notes.notes:
Happy Friday the 13th everyone! Our free content addition for Wick is now available to play. But be warned, there are many secrets buried within-- for those who can find their way through the darkness. 

Please note this is a small expansion for fans of the game who a) Enjoy the challenge of the original and B) are interested in exploring more of the Wick mystery. We loved watching everyone play and post their videos... so much that we wanted to create a little something extra for all of you who supported us at launch.

So we hope you enjoy the new scenes and story elements PLUS another intense romp through the woods with some familiar (and not so familiar) faces.

With a little digging, some of you may find more than that...

For some, there will be No Way Out.

BONUS!
We are also offering the game at 20% off for this new content launch (this is on top of our new bargain price of $5.99!). Tell your friends to pick it up if they haven't already. You can look  for secrets together!

notes.title: PRICE DROP + SALE + FREE CONTENT = A WICKED DEAL!
notes.notes:
It has been a busy time at Hellbent as we ready ourselves for this month's Game Developer's Conference AND put the final touches on our FREE content drop for Wick. Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we've dropped our base price to $9.99 AND, in our excitement, and have also thrown in a limited time discount! Tell your friends, this is the prime time to purchase and experience the new content when it releases in the coming weeks...

So what else can we tell you about this new content? We don't want to give away too much but we can say it goes back into the Wick timeline to explore the mystery from a "new perspective". As expected,  it's not going to be easy to survive as you search for the truth! 

 If you're a fan of our game, please let their friends know how much you've enjoyed playing so far. We want as many people as possible to have access to Wick-- since we plan to support it for a long time to come. Looking forward to another long night in the woods with you all!

notes.title: NEW CONTENT COMING FOR WICK!
notes.notes:
Congrats to those of you who have survived the night! Some great videos hitting YouTube and we love to see everyone working together to figure out the best strategies, and guessing at the mystery of Wick. 

But... dun dun DUN... its not over yet! With all the great feedback, we've decided to make some new content to release with our next major update. Any guesses on what we're going to do?

notes.title: What an amazing year!
notes.notes:
Wow! When we released Wick we hoped we would find people who wanted to play the game but we have been blown away by the response! So many people playing and so many YouTube videos! We love hearing about and watching you all freak out! Thank you so much for making our year amazing!

If you are interested in Wick but haven't bought it yet then you still have a few days left to get the launch discount price! When the Christmas sale is over the discount goes away so hurry and grab your copy today!
